To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a hybrid approach to mobile image classification is best suited for the current state of mobile devices.

(1) the best configuration for optimal run time (11% faster than the baseline) executes feature extraction on the mobile device using a GPU and offloads the remaining workload to the cloud, and (2) the best configuration to minimize energy usage (3x better than the baseline) is to compress and send the image over the wireless network.

a hybrid approach of executing feature extraction locally and matching remotely is the most energy efficient, while executing matching locally and feature extraction remotely is the most data efficient.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how much computation can be offloaded and how much data needs to be transferred to achieve optimal performance.
the design and evaluation of an offloading system that can be used for a wide range of vision applications.
the tradeoff of energy, runtime and data transfer in the offloading of mobile vision applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the hybrid approach (onboard feature extraction, offloaded matching and prediction) is the best configuration to achieve the optimal tradeoff between energy, runtime, and data transferred.
a hybrid approach is most suitable for image classification on mobile devices.
a hybrid approach of executing the feature extraction locally and offloading the rest of the computation is the most energy efficient.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a hybrid approach is the best option to achieve optimal runtime, while the best option to reduce energy consumption is to offload the whole pipeline.

offloading the prediction phase to a server is the most energy efficient solution, but offloading the feature extraction phase to a server and executing the matching phase onboard is the fastest option.
the best configuration depends on the scenario and that there are tradeoffs to consider.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a hybrid approach is the best solution for image classification.
a hybrid approach is best suited for offloading vision applications on a mobile platform.
the best option for offloading depends on the application, the network, and the hardware platform.
